I left Vermont mortgaged for now: lifting the mortgage would cost about $55 and earns nothing until I have the full set. Keeping my $817 lets me bid for Oriental, Atlantic or Baltic, and covers rent risk.

I'm also considering trying another trade with p4 for Marvin Gardens, even though they rejected it before.

Other color group trades seem tangled too—p3 holds Pennsylvania and Illinois, p4 has NC and Marvin, and I'd rather just end my turn and conserve liquidity rather than unmortgage right now.
